import Uorc.Uorc.Core.PrefixSmoke
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000000
namespace PrivatePrefixSmoke
open Uorc.Uorc.Core

def opBudget : RuntimeResources.Budget := {maxWork:=100000000, maxOwnedBytes:=1000000000, maxOutputBytes:=100000000, maxFrames:=100}
def ledger : RuntimeMachineSemantic.Ledger := { RuntimeMachineSemantic.zeroLedger with semanticWork:=10, semanticStorageUnits:=3, peakSemanticStorageUnits:=4, outputBytes:=2, activeFrames:=1, peakFrames:=2, acceptedArchives:=1, basisObjects:=1 }
def semBudget (limit : UInt64) : RuntimeMachineSemantic.Budget := { RuntimeMachineEngine.freshSemanticBudget with maxSemanticWork:=limit }
def ins (opcode : RuntimeOpcode.Opcode) (a b : UInt64) : RuntimeMachineFixtures.Instruction := {opcode:=opcode,operand0:=a,operand1:=b,operand2:=0,operand3:=0,capturesA:=[],capturesB:=[],literal:=ByteArray.empty}
def block : RuntimeMachineFixtures.Block := {parameters:=[],resultType:=.sequence,instructions:=[ins .naturalConstant 7 0,ins .naturalConstant 0 0,ins .naturalDivide 2 1,ins .naturalToByte 1 0,ins .singletonSequence 1 0],returnDistance:=1,initialRelease:=[],releaseAfter:=[]}
def drive : Nat → RuntimeMachineEngine.State → RuntimeMachineEngine.State
 | 0,s => s
 | n+1,s => match RuntimeMachineEngine.semanticStatus s with
   | some _ => if s.mode == 2 then match s.disposition with | .cancelling => drive n (RuntimeMachineEngine.tick s) | _ => s else s
   | none => match s.disposition with | .running => drive n (RuntimeMachineEngine.tick s) | .cancelling => drive n (RuntimeMachineEngine.tick s) | _ => s

def errorCode (s:RuntimeMachineEngine.State) : Nat := match RuntimeMachineEngine.semanticStatus s with
 | none => 0 | some .workLimit => 1 | some .storageLimit => 2 | some .wordOverflow => 3 | some _ => 4

def observe (s:RuntimeMachineEngine.State) : List UInt64 := [s.semanticLedger.semanticWork,s.semanticLedger.semanticStorageUnits,s.semanticLedger.peakSemanticStorageUnits,s.semanticLedger.outputBytes,s.semanticLedger.activeFrames,s.semanticLedger.peakFrames,s.semanticLedger.acceptedArchives,s.semanticLedger.basisObjects] ++ (match s.frames with | [] => [0,0,0] | f::_ => [f.frame.nextInstruction,f.phase,f.semanticPosition])

def run : Except String (List UInt64 × List UInt64 × List UInt64 × Nat × Bool × Bool × Bool × Bool × Bool) := do
 let ready ← match RuntimeMachineFixtures.ready [block] 0 [] with | .ok r => .ok r | .error _ => .error "fixture"
 let initial := RuntimeMachineEngine.startWithSemantic ready opBudget (semBudget 14) ledger
 let refused := drive 100000 initial
 if errorCode refused != 1 then throw "expectedSemanticWorkRefusal"
 if refused.semanticLedger.semanticWork != 14 then throw "expectedAcceptedWork14"
 let cursorOk := match refused.frames with | f::_ => f.frame.nextInstruction == 2 && f.phase == 32 && f.semanticPosition == 2 | [] => false
 if !cursorOk then throw "expectedPaidCursor2"
 let ticked := RuntimeMachineEngine.tick refused
 let inert := ticked.usage.work == refused.usage.work && ticked.arena.nextHandle == refused.arena.nextHandle && ticked.semanticLedger.semanticWork == 14 && errorCode ticked == 1
 let cancelledRefusal := drive 100000 (RuntimeMachineEngine.cancel refused)
 let cancelledTransfer ← match RuntimeMachineEngine.takeReady cancelledRefusal with | .ok r => .ok r | .error _ => .error "takeReadyRefusal"
 let preemption := errorCode cancelledRefusal == 1 && cancelledTransfer.semanticLedger.semanticWork == 14 && cancelledTransfer.semanticBudget.maxSemanticWork == 14
 let retried := drive 100000 (RuntimeMachineEngine.extendSemantic refused (semBudget 100))
 let division := match retried.disposition with | .failed (.semantic .divisionByZero) => true | _ => false
 let arenaSame := refused.arena.nextHandle == retried.arena.nextHandle && refused.arena.ownedBytes == retried.arena.ownedBytes
 let cleanup := drive 100000 (RuntimeMachineEngine.cancel retried)
 let transfer ← match RuntimeMachineEngine.takeReady cleanup with | .ok r => .ok r | .error _ => .error "takeReady"
 let handed := transfer.semanticLedger.semanticWork == 15 && transfer.semanticLedger.semanticStorageUnits == 3 && transfer.semanticBudget.maxSemanticWork == 100
 if !(division && arenaSame && handed && inert && preemption) then throw "expectedHeldTransferAndCleanup"
 return (observe initial,observe refused,observe retried,errorCode refused,division,arenaSame,handed,inert,preemption)
end PrivatePrefixSmoke
def main : IO Unit := do
 match PrivatePrefixSmoke.run with
 | .ok result => IO.println (reprStr result)
 | .error failure => throw (IO.userError failure)

strict_assertions: semantic workLimit before prepare at work14/pc2/phase32/position2
divisionByZero after exactly one remaining reference charge at work15/position5
arena nextHandle and ownedBytes unchanged across retry
ordinary refused tick keeps work/handle/ledger/error unchanged
cancel while semanticErrorSome reaches cleaned and retains typed refusal/ledger
ReadyTransfer preserves semantic ledger and budget

limitations: Native Lean/C diagnostic execution is not the requested accepted Rust package.
No RSS, allocation/copy instrumentation or physical bound was measured.
No full semantic-budget admissibility, complete event coverage, global cache/reference refinement, wire/admission equivalence or pinned SDK acceptance is established.
